data.name: Varishansh
data.gender_notes: Varishansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Varishansh is a powerful and majestic name, derived from the name of Lord Vishnu, the king of gods in Hindu mythology. The name is a blend of Vaari and Ishan, which mean 'king' and 'lord of the universe', respectively. The name Varishansh carries the meaning “King of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Varishansh usually hope their child will grow to embody king of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with divine energy, Varishansh symbolizes power, strength, and intelligence. It is a name that is revered and respected, and one that inspires awe and admiration.
data.etymology: Varishansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Varishansh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

This name is especially revered in Hindu communities and is considered a mark of respect towards their rich cultural heritage and religious beliefs. It is often given to children as a powerful and spiritual name, reflecting their divine connection to the Gods.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Varishansh signifies the inner power and strength of an individual, reminding them of their divine connection to Lord Vishnu and the universe. It is believed to bring peace, prosperity, and protection to the bearer of this name. The spiritual significance of the name serves as a constant reminder to live a virtuous and righteous life, inspired by the divine qualities of Lord Vishnu, and to seek his grace and blessings in all endeavors.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Varishansh is believed to originate from the Sanskrit words "Vari" meaning many and "Shansh" meaning wishes or desires. This name symbolizes one who has the ability to manifest numerous desires through determination and focus. It is a name that encourages the pursuit of one's dreams and the fulfillment of deepest aspirations.
